title: Kissed Citrusy Syrian Pumpkin Tagine
description: A macrobiotic friendly Syrian dish featuring roasted pumpkin and a blend of citrusy spices, this tagine is perfect for a cold winter night. It is a hearty and adventurous meal that combines the warmth of cumin and coriander with the brightness of citrus.
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the pumpkin cubes with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the pumpkin cubes out in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 30 minutes.
In a large pan, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the pan and cook until it is softened and translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the pan and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the ground cumin and ground coriander and cook for 1 minute.
Add the roasted pumpkin, lemon juice, and orange juice to the pan and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes.
